name: Dad
art_prompt: a goofy suburban dad with a bald head, a thick brown mustache, a grey T-shirt, khaki shorts, white socks and sandals, a proud smile
motion: jogging in place, arms pumping, belly bouncing a little
portrait_prompt: grinning proudly with both thumbs up, his thick brown mustache and shiny bald head, a barbecue apron strap on one shoulder
anim_hint: a goofy stocky suburban dad with a round belly, bald with a thick brown mustache, grey T-shirt, khaki shorts, white socks and sandals, jogging with short bouncy steps and the arms swinging
anim_negative: hair on the head, hat, long trousers
trait_text: +25% might and +15% area, but −10% move speed. His Boomstick fires two extra pellets.
pose_hint: Both arms hang straight down at his sides, hands open and relaxed, not raised, not bent. The same stocky build with the round belly and short legs in every view.
back_hint: He faces away from the viewer: only the back of his bald head, the back of the grey T-shirt and the heels are visible, no eyes, no mustache, no face at all.
side_hint: In strict profile: the round belly pushing the T-shirt out in front, the bald head and the mustache seen from the side, the same short stocky proportions as the front view.
hurt_hint: mustache intact, eyes squeezed shut, belly clenched
